en: Good morning, Kaito.
Oh... Hey, bro!

Perfect timing.
Can I get your opinion on something?
Huh? For what?
Well, it's about our training...

Like I said before, my training is based
on a systematic method.
But, I feel like something's missing...
You do...?

<CLT=cltMIND>We've only done sit-ups and
push-ups so far...

Even if I don't need it myself, 
in order for you two to grow...

I feel like we should add something like martial
arts or some kind of mental training...

Now that you mention it,
I do have a practice sword...

Oh! Good idea! Practicing with those
will be a great training exercise.

Alright! Let's not wait till night! We're gonna
do this special training as soon as possible!
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltMIND>Would you like to go with Kaito?
Ah, I'm actually okay...

Hey! You were the one who suggested it!
Changing your mind is really unmanly, y'know!?

B-But, I don't know if it's a good idea to
swing a sword around, even a fake one...

Oh, yeah...that's true.
In that case...

Let's do zen meditation...
We'll meditate on what we should do.

Well, let's go to breakfast for now.
I'll go on ahead.

<CLT=cltMIND>Zen meditation in the courtyard?
That might be tough on the legs...
Alright, I got it.

It's decided! I'll bring Maki Roll, so let's 
meet at the usual place!

But first, breakfast.
I'll see ya there!

We'll meditate on what we should do.
But let's eat first.
I'll go on ahead. Don't be late, bro!
Yeah!
Heyyyy! Come ouuuut!
Where you hiding! Come talk to Gonta!

Gonta? What's wrong?
Are you looking for someone?
Oh! Good morning, Shuichi!

Gonta not looking for person.
Gonta looking for tiny bug.

Ah, yes, I was wondering about that.
Have you found any?
Well...Gonta no can find him.

Gonta see him lots of times, so Gonta
pretty sure it not mistake...
I see...
But Gonta happy Shuichi love bugs so much!

Huh?
Ah, um, I don't like bugs *that* much...
What!? You hate bugs, Shuichi!?

N-No! I love them, Gonta!
I said that before, right?

Oh yeah. You good person, so of course
you like bugs.

Alright! Gonta go find tiny bug for Shuichi!
No matter what it take!
Look forward to it!

Ah...I still get chills thinking about
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Insect Meet and Greet<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

<CLT=cltMIND>When I used the item, the vine suddenly
withered... How does that work?
